Wild Area.description:
GO Wild Area returns in 2026 with Steel- and Dragon-type Pokémon, the debuts of Dynamax Dialga and Dynamax Palkia, and powerful mighty Pokémon. Collect GO Safari Balls to help catch these challenging encounters!
Dates: November 6, 7, or 8, 2026 Time: 10:00 a.m. – 6:00 p.m. local time (UTC−6) Location: Mexico City, Mexico, with gameplay throughout the metropolitan area Ticket: MXN$350 (plus applicable taxes and fees) for one day
All event gameplay is exclusive to ticket holders. A standard ticket covers one selected day; Extra Day add-ons extend eligible gameplay to additional days. Gameplay is available only within the event area at the date and time specified on your ticket.
Tickets are available on the official event ticket page, while supplies last.

Season.description:
Welcome to Pokémon GO: Twilight Trails!
In Pokémon GO, Seasons are periods of time that feature new events, Pokémon debuts, and surprises that all follow a certain theme. As the Seasons change, you may find different Pokémon appearing in your area and hatching from Eggs. Make sure to explore during each in-game Season to collect and train as many different Pokémon as you can! You’ll also enjoy special bonuses as you do.

Research.title: adidas × Pokémon Timed Research
Research.description:
Celebrate the adidas × Pokémon collection with Timed Research at participating adidas and retail stores worldwide!
Research is available starting September 25, 2026, through January 15, 2027, at 8:00 p.m. local time. The exact start time has not been announced.
